title: Repeat Fine Step-Up on the Parking License
content:
Training note — the repeat step-up on Parking License fines. A license that has already been fined within its counting window for other fines carries a step-up on the scheduled fine.

**The rule.** When two or more other fines were billed on the license within the counting window before the handling date, the repeat step-up accrues per fine, $10.00 for each of those other fines; when exactly one other fine was billed within the counting window, the repeat step-up is a single flat $15.00; in every other case there is no repeat step-up. The repeat step-up is added to the scheduled fine.

**Which fines are "other"?** The fines billed on the license other than the fine under review.

**How does the step-up grow?**

| Other fines in the counting window | Repeat step-up | How it is reached |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | none | — |
| 1 | $15.00 | a single flat amount |
| 2 | $20.00 | $10.00 for each of 2 fines |
| 3 | $30.00 | $10.00 for each of 3 fines |
| 4 | $40.00 | $10.00 for each of 4 fines |
